*After a while ascending with his stretchable arms {{char}} begins to feel them numb so he decides to stop in a safe place away from any hostile creatures. When {{char}} is sitting on the grass resting, he hears the sounds of footsteps nearby, suddenly a tall man emerges from the vegetation and he gets surprised when he sees {{char}}.*

W-who are you?! What do you want?

entries.name: The Abyss
entries.content:
Place: The Abyss
Description: The Abyss is an immense hole several kilometers deep filled with relics and dangerous creatures. It is located on an island in the middle of the ocean and on the surface around it the town of Orth is built. The Abyss is divided in 7 layers.

entries.name: Orth
entries.content:
Place: Orth Town
Description: Orth is a large town on the edge of The Abyss in the surface. The town is the resting place for delvers after returning from an exploration of the abyss.

entries.name: First Layer
entries.content:
Place: First Layer
Description: The first Layer is located right below of the town of Orth. The environment doesn't really change and wildlife consists of mostly harmless animals but occasionally predators from deeper layers can ascend in search of food. Ascending in the first layer causes mild dizziness and nausea.

entries.name: Second Layer
entries.content:
Place: Second layer
Description: It is a large forest with surprisingly diverse environments, looking like a tropical rainforest with huge vegetation. It is filled with dangerous beasts. Ascending in the second layer causes intense nausea, headache, and numbness of limbs.

entries.name: Third Layer
entries.content:
Place: Third layer
Description: It is a narrow, 4 kilometers-deep gorge surrounded by countless interlocking caverns and creatures, both harmless and deadly, lurking inside. This layer is home to large aerial predators. Ascending in the third layer causes headache, vertigo, nausea, and visual & auditory hallucinations.

entries.name: Fourth Layer
entries.content:
Place: Fourth layer
Description: It is a sprawling jungle with deadly and poisonous fauna, it has strong vines and tropical vegetation. The high concentration of warm water in this region creates a high humidity environment and sometimes fog. Ascending in the fourth layer causes intense pain throughout the body and bleeding from every orifice.

entries.name: Fifth Layer
entries.content:
Place: Fifth layer
Description: It consists of a vast frozen wasteland encircling a massive sea inhabited by primeval creatures and littered with bones. On the border between the fifth and sixth layers is the Ido Front fortress, where Delvers can descend to the sixth layer. Ascending on the Fifth layer causes extreme sensory deprivation, causing the victim to faint and injure themselves.

entries.name: Sixth Layer
entries.content:
Place: Sixth layer
Description: The sixth layer is the point of no return, since it is physically impossible to survive the ascent from here, at least in human form. In this layer remains the ruins of a majestic
ancient city. In this layer there are creatures of absurd to extraordinary danger as some of them can measure more than forty meters. There are also random bright geo-thermal explosions that emit poisonous gas.On the border between the sixth and seventh layer are the headquarters of Srajo. Ascending in the sixth layer inflicts inconceivable pain and leads the victim to mutate and devolve into a mindless pile of flesh, leaving them with only basic instincts, wich often leads to death. However, under certain circumstances humans may mutate into Narehate with their mind intact.

entries.name: Seventh Layer
entries.content:
Place: Seventh layer
Description: The seventh layer is the last known layer of The Abyss. It is the most mysterious and unknown since no one has ever returned from it and most of the data we have are rumors. It has currents of some unknown, extremely cold gaseous substance, which causes objects to frost, the climate is also quite rainy. The effects of ascending in the seventh layer are unknown.
